evidence_summary: REST insert accepted string-encoded vector '[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]' for FloatVector field with HTTP 200 and code=0; subsequent search successfully found the entity with distance=1
rationale: Type1 contract violation: the schema defines field 'vector' with dataType FloatVector, which should be an array of float numbers; the REST endpoint accepted a string representation '[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]' instead of an actual float array, violating the FloatVector field type constraint
